backend: native FreeRTOS / AMD lwIP; dummy 48 kHz audio
provenance: Recorded base commit plus uncommitted health-source implementation; exact source-input digest is in the manifest. The later automatic interface-reset-release fix was not in the tested ELF.
launch: Factory BOOT.BIN/FSBL/U-Boot; separate FAT ELF at 0x38000000; fresh boot nonce; bootelf -p
final_state: Firmware intentionally stopped, networking service cleaned up; board still powered. Reset required for another launch.
thermal_limitations: Sampled telemetry and a host-side probe stop do not guarantee local PS protection or whole-board power cutoff. Sensor maximum is hardware-retained, not a peak-since-boot claim.
